lines.zh: 我从水里爬上来，壳上还在滴水。
lines.en: I haul out of the water, my shell still dripping.

lines.zh: 四条腿撑起这个壳，走一步晃一下。
lines.en: Four legs lift this shell; each step sways.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸的泥坡往上挪。
lines.en: I creep up the muddy slope of the riverbank.

lines.zh: 爪子刨进湿土，留下三趾的印。
lines.en: Claws dig into wet soil, leaving three-toed prints.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，壳不允许。
lines.en: I do not walk fast; the shell forbids it.

lines.zh: 一路踩断枯枝，声音比步子大。
lines.en: I snap dead twigs; the noise outruns my pace.

lines.zh: 同伴跟在半尺后，我们都不说话。
lines.en: My companion trails half a foot behind, silent.

lines.zh: 我绕过树根，壳沿擦过树皮。
lines.en: I go around a root, shell scraping bark.

lines.zh: 太阳照在背上，我走得更慢。
lines.en: Sun on my back slows me further.

lines.zh: 我把头侧着收进壳里，继续走。
lines.en: I fold my head sideways into the shell and keep going.

lines.zh: 泥从壳缝里挤出来，落在地上。
lines.en: Mud squeezes from my shell seams and drops away.

lines.zh: 我每一步都先试探地面。
lines.en: Every step tests the ground before my weight follows.

lines.zh: 草高过我的背，我照样直线走。
lines.en: The grass is taller than my back; I walk straight anyway.

lines.zh: 上岸是我一天里最费力的事。
lines.en: Climbing ashore is the hardest part of my day.

lines.zh: 我停一下，把壳里的水倒出去。
lines.en: I stop to tip the water out of my shell.

lines.zh: 岸边的草压下去，又被我踩回来。
lines.en: The bank grass bends down, then back under my steps.

lines.zh: 我走几步就抬头，看看太阳在哪。
lines.en: Every few steps I look up to find the sun.

lines.zh: 爪子在石头上打滑，我换个方向。
lines.en: My claws slip on stone, so I change direction.

lines.zh: 我趴在岸上晒壳，一动不动。
lines.en: I lie on the bank drying my shell, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 头侧着伸出去，风从颈侧过。
lines.en: My head stretches out sideways; wind passes my neck.

lines.zh: 壳晒热了，我能感到里面也暖。
lines.en: The shell warms, and I feel the warmth inside too.

lines.zh: 一只有翅的虫落在我背上。
lines.en: A winged insect lands on my back.

lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，然后又不动了。
lines.en: I blink once, then go still again.

lines.zh: 同伴在两步外挖坑。
lines.en: My companion is digging a hole two steps away.

lines.zh: 水声一直在，我听着它。
lines.en: The river never stops; I listen to it.

lines.zh: 我把脖子慢慢转到另一边。
lines.en: I turn my neck slowly to the other side.

lines.zh: 壳上的泥干了，开始裂开。
lines.en: The mud on my shell dries and begins to crack.

lines.zh: 我不需要做什么，也没人催我。
lines.en: I need do nothing, and no one hurries me.

lines.zh: 我长长的脖子搭在石头上。
lines.en: My long neck rests across a stone.

lines.zh: 潮气让壳边长出绿苔。
lines.en: The damp grows green moss along my shell rim.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，没吃，只是透气。
lines.en: I open my mouth not to eat but to breathe.

lines.zh: 这一带没有比我更慢的东西。
lines.en: Nothing in this stretch is slower than I am.

lines.zh: 我把一条腿伸出去，很久没收回来。
lines.en: I stretch one leg out and take a long time to pull it back.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在壳上，我让它歇着。
lines.en: A bird lands on my shell. I let it rest.

lines.zh: 你走近，我先看你脚上的泥。
lines.en: As you approach, I look first at the mud on your boots.

lines.zh: 我侧颈一歪，用左眼看你。
lines.en: I cock my side-neck and fix you with my left eye.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在壳上，凉了一块。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my shell and cools a patch.

lines.zh: 我看你很久，你以为我没在看。
lines.en: I watch you a long time; you think I am not.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我们的眼睛差不多高。
lines.en: You crouch, and our eyes come nearly level.

lines.zh: 我缓缓眨眼，这是最快的回应。
lines.en: I blink slowly; it is the fastest reply I have.

lines.zh: 你伸手时，我脖子缩回半寸。
lines.en: When you reach out, my neck pulls back an inch.

lines.zh: 你这身颜色在丛林里很显眼。
lines.en: Your colors stand out badly in this jungle.

lines.zh: 我先看你的手，再看你的脸。
lines.en: I look at your hands first, then your face.

lines.zh: 你看了我三分钟，我动了一次。
lines.en: You watch three minutes; I move once.

lines.zh: 我在估你是不是要摸我的壳。
lines.en: I am judging whether you mean to touch my shell.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸惊动了一只蚊，它飞走了。
lines.en: Your breath stirs a mosquito, and it leaves.

lines.zh: 这一下只刮掉我壳上的泥。
lines.en: That only scraped mud off my shell.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，你打在石头上。
lines.en: I pull in; you strike stone.

lines.zh: 疼，但壳还在。
lines.en: It hurts, but the shell holds.

lines.zh: 我的脖子缩得比你的手快。
lines.en: My neck retracts faster than your hand.

lines.zh: 十下八下，我还能爬。
lines.en: Eight or ten blows, and I can still crawl.

lines.zh: 壳上又添一道白痕，不深。
lines.en: Another white mark on the shell, not deep.

lines.zh: 我闷哼一声，往前挪了挪。
lines.en: I grunt once and shuffle forward.

lines.zh: 你打不透这层骨。
lines.en: You cannot punch through this bone.

lines.zh: 血从壳缝渗出，我照旧趴着。
lines.en: Blood seeps between my shell plates; I keep lying there.

lines.zh: 想撬开我，得先翻过来。
lines.en: To get at me, you must flip me first.

lines.zh: 你手里有甜的东西，我闻到了。
lines.en: You carry something sweet; I smell it.

lines.zh: 我朝你挪了半步，很慢。
lines.en: I shift half a step your way, slowly.

lines.zh: 叶子比肉更合我的口。
lines.en: Leaves suit my mouth better than meat.

lines.zh: 那片果子在你掌心，我看得清。
lines.en: That fruit in your palm is perfectly clear to me.

lines.zh: 我伸出脖子，又收回来。
lines.en: I stretch my neck out, then draw it back.

lines.zh: 水草的味道从你袋子里漏出来。
lines.en: The smell of waterweed leaks from your bag.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我等它掉下来。
lines.en: I do not snatch; I wait for it to fall.

lines.zh: 你把草举高，我的脖子够得到。
lines.en: You raise the greens; my neck can reach them.

lines.zh: 我张嘴咬住，慢慢嚼。
lines.en: I take it and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 甜味让我忘了壳有多重。
lines.en: Sweetness makes me forget the weight of my shell.

lines.zh: 再来一片，我就跟你走。
lines.en: One more leaf and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 这东西在水里找不到。
lines.en: This does not grow in the water.

lines.zh: 我吞下去，脖子鼓了一下。
lines.en: I swallow, and my neck bulges once.

lines.zh: 你手别动，我吃得很慢。
lines.en: Keep your hand still; I eat slowly.

lines.zh: 你把叶子放在我嘴边，我咬了一小口。
lines.en: You put a leaf by my mouth. I take a small bite.

lines.zh: 水里的嫩芽比岸上的香。
lines.en: The shoots in the water smell better than the ones on land.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的壳，退的是你。
lines.en: You hit my shell; you are the one who recoils.

lines.zh: 我这身壳，撞起来像石头。
lines.en: This shell of mine strikes like stone.

lines.zh: 我被推了一点，脚下的泥滑了。
lines.en: I slide a little as the mud gives under me.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴，我缩了头。
lines.en: You step on my tail and I pull my head in.

lines.zh: 同伴被挤开，壳碰壳响了一声。
lines.en: My companion is shoved aside; shell knocks shell.

lines.zh: 我顶回去，只用了一点力气。
lines.en: I push back with very little force.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞在壳沿，疼的是你。
lines.en: Your knee meets my shell rim; the pain is yours.

lines.zh: 我把身体横过来，堵住这条路。
lines.en: I turn broadside and block the trail.

lines.zh: 泥地上留下两道拖痕。
lines.en: Two drag marks remain in the mud.

lines.zh: 别从后面推，我会回头咬。
lines.en: Do not push from behind; I will turn and bite.

lines.zh: 我们两只一起上岸，这就是仪式。
lines.en: The two of us coming ashore together is the whole ritual.

lines.zh: 我用头蹭她颈侧的那层皮。
lines.en: I rub my head against the skin of her neck.

lines.zh: 壳碰壳的声音很轻，像木头。
lines.en: Shell against shell sounds soft, like wood.

lines.zh: 我们挖同一个坑，谁也不让。
lines.en: We dig the same hole and neither gives way.

lines.zh: 她比我大一圈，我不介意。
lines.en: She is a size larger; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 河岸的沙够软，可以埋。
lines.en: The riverbank sand is soft enough to bury in.

lines.zh: 我守在她旁边，直到太阳偏西。
lines.en: I stay beside her until the sun slants west.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后下水，没有告别。
lines.en: We enter the water one after the other, no farewell.

lines.zh: 求偶不需要叫，只需要等。
lines.en: Courting needs no call, only patience.

lines.zh: 这一窝蛋，谁也别靠近。
lines.en: No one comes near this clutch.

lines.zh: 我咬了一下，觉得不是吃的。
lines.en: I bite it and decide it is not food.

lines.zh: 东西掉在泥里，我用鼻子顶。
lines.en: It falls in the mud; I nudge it with my snout.

lines.zh: 我把它推到水边，没再管。
lines.en: I shove it to the water's edge and forget it.

lines.zh: 壳太重，我弯不下腰去捡。
lines.en: My shell is too heavy to bend down and pick things up.

lines.zh: 你掉的果子，我替你收了。
lines.en: The fruit you dropped, I have taken for you.

lines.zh: 我嘴里一次只能含一样。
lines.en: My mouth holds one thing at a time.

lines.zh: 这块布卡在我爪缝里。
lines.en: This scrap of cloth is stuck between my claws.

lines.zh: 我不捡亮的，只捡能吃的。
lines.en: I take nothing shiny, only what can be eaten.

lines.zh: 它滚进水里，我就不追了。
lines.en: It rolls into the water; I stop following.

lines.zh: 你看着我拿走，也没拦。
lines.en: You watch me take it and do not stop me.

lines.zh: 有东西在草丛里动，我停下了。
lines.en: Something moves in the grass; I stop.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，脖子伸得很长。
lines.en: I lift my head, neck stretched long.

lines.zh: 那影子不像是植物。
lines.en: That shadow is not a plant.

lines.zh: 我看清了，是一只要下水的兽。
lines.en: I see it now: a beast heading for the water.

lines.zh: 它要是过来，我就往水里退。
lines.en: If it comes near, I retreat to the water.

lines.zh: 我的头已经转向那个方向。
lines.en: My head has already turned that way.

lines.zh: 它踩断了一根枝，我听见了。
lines.en: It snaps a twig; I hear it.

lines.zh: 这声音我记下了，很轻。
lines.en: I have noted that sound; it was faint.

lines.zh: 目标在动，我就慢慢跟着转。
lines.en: As the target moves, I turn slowly with it.

lines.zh: 反正我不赶路，慢慢耗它。
lines.en: I am not going anywhere; I outlast it.

lines.zh: 我压低脖子，壳遮住半边。
lines.en: I lower my neck; the shell hides half of me.

lines.zh: 它离水只有几步，我先到。
lines.en: It is steps from water; I get there first.

lines.zh: 我看它落脚的泥，那里最滑。
lines.en: I watch where it plants its feet, on the slickest mud.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我的嘴就够到了。
lines.en: A little closer and my mouth will reach.

lines.zh: 它没看见我，我的壳像块石头。
lines.en: It has not seen me; my shell looks like stone.

lines.zh: 我把身体挪正，慢慢对准。
lines.en: I shift my body square and slowly aim.

lines.zh: 呼吸放轻，脖子保持不动。
lines.en: Breath slows; my neck holds still.

lines.zh: 这个距离，只有一次机会。
lines.en: At this distance I get one chance.

lines.zh: 我数着它的脚步，一步一顿。
lines.en: I count its steps, one pause at a time.

lines.zh: 我的心跳很慢，它很快。
lines.en: My heart is slow; its heart is fast.

lines.zh: 咬住之后，我的脖子往后收。
lines.en: Once I bite, my neck pulls back hard.

lines.zh: 我这嘴没有牙，只有硬边。
lines.en: My mouth has no teeth, only a hard edge.

lines.zh: 脖子一伸，快得不像我。
lines.en: My neck shoots out faster than I look.

lines.zh: 它被拽了一下，摔在泥里。
lines.en: One yank and it lands in the mud.

lines.zh: 我用壳顶它，把它推下坡。
lines.en: I shove with my shell and roll it downslope.

lines.zh: 咬合力比我外表厉害。
lines.en: My bite is stronger than my looks suggest.

lines.zh: 它挣了两下，我不动。
lines.en: It struggles twice; I do not budge.

lines.zh: 血滴在壳上，被雨水冲掉。
lines.en: Blood drips on my shell and the rain washes it off.

lines.zh: 我不杀它，我只要它让开。
lines.en: I do not kill it; I only want it to move.

lines.zh: 松开时，它已经跑远了。
lines.en: When I let go, it is already far.

lines.zh: 我从丛林边的河里爬上这片岸。
lines.en: I climb onto this bank from a jungle river.

lines.zh: 沙是热的，正好埋蛋。
lines.en: The sand is warm, right for burying eggs.

lines.zh: 我身边还跟着一只，一起到。
lines.en: One more came with me; we arrived together.

lines.zh: 壳上还带着河底的泥。
lines.en: River-bottom mud still clings to my shell.

lines.zh: 我出生在这条河，只认这条河。
lines.en: I was born in this river and know only this river.

lines.zh: 这片岸上草很深，够我藏。
lines.en: The grass here is deep enough to hide me.

lines.zh: 我第一次上岸，爬得很慢。
lines.en: My first climb ashore was very slow.

lines.zh: 太阳照在湿壳上，冒了白气。
lines.en: Sun on my wet shell raises a little steam.

lines.zh: 我找了一块平地，趴下了。
lines.en: I find flat ground and settle down.

lines.zh: 让一让，我要去那块石头晒壳。
lines.en: Step aside; I am bound for that basking stone.

lines.zh: 壳烫得我探出脖子。
lines.en: The shell burns hot and my neck thrusts out.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，壳先着地。
lines.en: I roll down the slope, shell first.

lines.zh: 我沉在水底，憋得壳发闷。
lines.en: I sink and hold, the shell dulling around me.

lines.zh: 冲击把我和泥一起掀翻。
lines.en: The blast flips me over with the mud.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进我的背甲，很难受。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my back plate, and it aches.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的壳发木。
lines.en: That light leaves my shell wooden and dull.

lines.zh: 岸上的果子吃完了，我去水里找。
lines.en: The fruit is gone; I search the water.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，壳里嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and my shell hums.

lines.zh: 岸没有了，我伸长脖子找水。
lines.en: The bank is gone; I stretch my neck for water.
